justification: Both surfaces depict a harnessed equine in strict profile, accompanied by human figures, set above a continuous horizontal ornamental border band, and both use the same shallow-relief, outline-plus-incised-detail convention with patterned rendering of mane/hair. The clearest difference is subject matter: A is an orderly processional scene with a spoked-wheel chariot and standing charioteer, whereas B shows a collapsing/lunging animal in a turbulent, overlapping composition with no vehicle.
